mapper.select: INSERT INTO answer_record (tenant_id, user_id, question, answer_text, refused, refusal_reason, top_relevance, rewritten_question) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{question}, #{answerText}, #{refused}, #{refusalReason}, #{topRelevance}, #{rewrittenQuestion}) RETURNING id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO answer_citation (answer_id, citation_index, chunk_id, document_id, document_name, heading_path) VALUES (#{answerId}, #{index}, #{chunkId}, #{documentId}, #{documentName}, #{headingPath})
mapper.select:
SELECT r.id, r.user_id, r.question, r.answer_text, r.refused, r.refusal_reason, r.top_relevance, r.rating, r.feedback_comment, r.created_at, r.rewritten_question, r.review_status, r.resolution_note, r.resolved_at, (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT c.document_name, chr(31)) FROM answer_citation c WHERE c.answer_id = r.id) AS cited_documents FROM answer_record r
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT count(*) AS questions, count(DISTINCT user_id) AS askers, count(*) FILTER (WHERE refused) AS refused, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT refused AND rating IS NOT NULL) AS rated, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT refused AND rating = 'UP') AS liked, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT refused AND rating = 'DOWN') AS disliked, count(*) FILTER (WHERE review_status = 'OPEN' AND (refused OR rating = 'DOWN')) AS open_reviews FROM answer_record WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to}

SELECT CAST(created_at AT TIME ZONE #{zone} AS date) AS day, count(*) AS questions, count(*) FILTER (WHERE refused) AS refused, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT refused AND rating = 'DOWN') AS disliked FROM answer_record WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to} GROUP BY day

SELECT refusal_reason AS label, count(*) AS count FROM answer_record WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to} AND refused GROUP BY refusal_reason ORDER BY count DESC, refusal_reason

SELECT question AS label, count(*) AS count FROM answer_record WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to} AND refused GROUP BY question ORDER BY count DESC, max(created_at) DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.document_name AS label, count(DISTINCT c.answer_id) AS count FROM answer_citation c JOIN answer_record r ON r.id = c.answer_id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.created_at >= #{from} AND r.created_at < #{to} GROUP BY c.document_name ORDER BY count DESC, c.document_name LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE answer_record SET review_status = #{status}, resolution_note = #{note}, resolved_by = #{resolvedBy}, resolved_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'RESOLVED' THEN now() ELSE NULL END WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id}

UPDATE answer_record SET rating = #{rating}, feedback_comment = #{comment}, rated_at = CASE WHEN CAST(#{rating} AS varchar) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE now() END WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id}
